appearance_facts.fact: The blue solid line (Industry) has a data point that is physically higher on the page (closer to the top edge) than the red dashed line (Agriculture) data point.

The blue line generally occupies the upper half of the chart for the years 2011 through 2018, whereas the red line generally occupies the lower half.
The blue marker is a circle and the red marker is a square; the blue circle is positioned vertically above the red square.

The right vertical axis is labeled 'Industry (%)' in red text.
The horizontal axis is labeled 'Year' with ticks for 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018.
